name: @crabgic/e2e
description: Phase 23 release-hardening top-level E2E tooling (not an npm workspace member — roadmap/23-release-hardening.md's own header: "lives under top-level e2e/ (not an npm workspace member)"). e2e/provisioning/ (this work item): disposable-environment provisioning + guaranteed-teardown harness. e2e/report/ is a sibling worker's directory (release-gate-report generator) and is untouched here.
note_no_install: Deps above are declared for documentation/version-pinning only, matching versions already present in the repo root's node_modules (root package.json + packages/contracts). Per this work item's constraint ("Do NOT run npm install / edit package-lock"), no install was run against this file — Node's ancestor node_modules resolution finds zod/vitest/typescript from the repo-root node_modules/ at runtime/build time without a workspace entry, and `npx <tool>` from repo root resolves the same root-installed binaries.
